purpose: Teach: 行お/コンパイラ/スタック/アクセシビリティ/ラーニング/ウィークリー/インスピレーション/もうける

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査を実際に行おうとされてますね
lines.en: The police actually do conduct investigations, don't they.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Acknowledging facts as they're understood. Slight uplift at the end—inviting agreement, not challenging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者使用のコンパイラ解析もされますね
lines.en: The police also analyze compilers used by suspects, don't they.
lines.style: Same measured rhythm. Light emphasis on 「also」—building a list. Still cooperative in tone. Calm, methodical, like walking through steps.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品のスタック管理もされますね
lines.en: The police manage the storage and cataloging of seized items too, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the same cadence. Warm but factual. No surprise in the voice—just steady acknowledgment of the work that gets done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署のアクセシビリティ改善もされますね
lines.en: The police are also working on improving accessibility at the station, aren't they.
lines.style: Slight softness here—noticing something good. Still the same measured pace. A touch of appreciation without overdoing it. Genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯Eラーニングを市民に提供されますね
lines.en: The police provide crime prevention e-learning to the community as well, don't they.
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. The rhythm stays even. Light emphasis on 「community」—recognizing outreach work. Respectful of the effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ウィークリーで犯罪情報を集約されますね
lines.en: The police aggregate crime information on a weekly basis, isn't that right.
lines.style: Still cooperative. A touch more present—checking in with the listener. Not interrogating, just confirming together. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人が映画からインスピレーションを得る事例も把握されますね
lines.en: The police are aware too that criminals sometimes get inspiration from movies, aren't they.
lines.style: Slight tilt toward curiosity here. Not accusatory. Acknowledging something both speakers understand. Even pacing, gentle delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪でもうける組織を解体されますね
lines.en: The police dismantle criminal organizations that profit from crime, don't they.
lines.style: Firmer now. Conviction in the voice without aggression. A weight of seriousness. The final statement—shorter, more direct. Respect for the work.
